artworks.title: Sur les boulevards de Paris
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two top-hatted figures conversing on a city street. They are examining a document. The setting is a Parisian boulevard with urban trees. Buildings fade into the background on the right. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Eh! Qu'est-ce qu'il y a de nouveau? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One person is partially visible with most of their upper body extended out of a doorway on the left side of the scene. The other person is shown from the waist up, standing near a staircase on the right side. The background features a simple interior setting with staircase railings and a blank wall.

artworks.title: Toast porté a  l'émancipation des femmes ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four women raising glasses in a toast. They vary in positions and hairstyles, two women sit and two stand. They wear dresses typical of the period. On the table are bottles and glasses. A decorative curtain hangs behind them.

artworks.title: Eh! Ben, v'la du propre! ... on dit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a room. One woman is seated on a couch facing the other woman standing next to her. The seated woman has hair in a bun and wears a long-sleeved dress. The standing woman has curly hair pulled back and wears a long fitted dress with a high collar. The room contains a vase on a table and an indistinct framed picture on the wall behind them.

artworks.title: Rifolard ... oublie ... les inconvénients de la traversée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in military-style uniform standing confidently in a crowd. The man stands with hands in his pockets and a plumed cap, surrounded by a varied group of onlookers including children and adults. The background hints at an urban setting with ship masts visible. The drawing is done in a textured, classic style emphasizing detail.

artworks.title: Et dire que Proudhon ne veut pas ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a room, a man and a woman. The man is sitting on a chair or low seat, with his full body visible, leaning forward slightly, resting his left elbow on his knee, and facing the woman. He has a receding hairline with a few long strands of hair on the sides and appears to be wearing glasses. His clothing consists of a long-sleeved robe or coat that flows down to the ground, and his hands are clasped together. The woman stands confidently beside him, with long hair flowing down over her shoulders and a headdress draping behind her head. She wears an elaborate long dress with a corset-like top and a shawl draped over her shoulders. Her right hand rests on the man's shoulder, while her left hand lies on a table covered with papers and a quill. The background includes a framed picture on the wall, a patterned radiator to the left, and a window or corner of the room to the right. Shadows on the wall create a sense of depth in the simply furnished room.

artworks.title: Luneau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated in a chair. He is sitting in a relaxed, slightly reclined position with his legs crossed. His head is exaggeratedly large, with prominent facial features including a pronounced chin and nose. He has short, curly hair and a thick beard. He is dressed in formal attire, wearing a suit jacket and striped trousers. He holds a document or book in one hand. The background includes a table with a cloth, a carafe, and a plate on it. The setting is depicted in black and white, with the rest of the page containing text and some faint outlines surrounding the central figure.

artworks.title: P.J. David D'Angers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man depicted in an exaggerated style. The man stands confidently with his hands on his hips and his feet turned outward. He has a large mustache, oversized head, furrowed brow, wide-set eyes, medium length dark hair, and is dressed in a dark top and pleated pants. The background has faint outlines of several indistinct figures, and the image is set on a light-colored textured surface with brownish spots.

artworks.title: L'heure de la rentrée en classe
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of exaggerated caricatured figures engaged in various activities. The central figure is a hunched man with a large nose holding a megaphone. The style resembles that of Honoré Daumier. In the foreground, the figure appears to be addressing others with the megaphone. Behind him, a collection of oddly shaped figures stands observing, each with distinct and exaggerated facial features. The setting seems outdoor, with a horizon line and a distant figure holding what appears to be a ribbon or kite string. The drawing uses sharp contrasts and detailed line work, typical of Daumier's satirical and critical renderings of society. The overall atmosphere suggests an interaction filled with irony and humor, characteristic of Daumier's commentary on human nature and behavior.

artworks.title: L'insurrection contre les maris ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three women stand closely together in 19th-century attire. The woman on the left gestures with a top hat towards the woman in the middle. The central woman reaches out with both hands, while the woman on the right holds a stick with a determined expression. Above them is the title "Les Femmes Socialistes," and below, the text reads: "L’insurrection contre les maris est proclamée le plus saint des devoirs !"

artworks.title: La femme du représentant
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are two people in the image. The person on the right is a man wearing a dark suit with a white shirt. He is adjusting his collar with both hands, and has short, curly, white hair. The person on the left, a woman, wears a headscarf and a long, patterned shawl. She appears to be looking into a wardrobe or mirror. In the background, there is a wall with two framed pictures.

artworks.title: Tu connais bien l'gros député d'en face ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures sitting on a ledge in an urban setting. In the background, there are tall, indistinct urban buildings. The drawing is monochrome, utilizing shading and linework for depth and texture. Fine lines and cross-hatching are used for shadows and to suggest materials. Text is integrated into the image beneath the scene.

artworks.title: Cotton Rat
artworks.artist: John T. Bowen, after John James Audubon
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Robert Scott Wiles, 1973)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is marked by trees and fencing, indicating a rural environment. In the distance, a small house with a smoking chimney can be seen among trees. Two cotton rats are prominently featured with detailed brushstrokes. The color palette is muted, with warm browns and greens dominating, and touches of pale blue and green in the background. The shading of animals and plants suggests a deliberate technique, providing a serene quality to the image.

artworks.title: Head of a Man with a Cap
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a person. They are shown from the shoulders up, in a three-quarter position facing the right side of the image. The individual has softly defined facial features with a pronounced nose and a contemplative expression. Their hair, which is medium-length and slightly wavy, extends to their neck and is covered by a head covering that blends with the hairstyle. The person is dressed in a garment that covers up to the neckline, resembling a robe or coat with simple lines. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: New Bedford, Massachusetts
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river, trees, rocks, and a town silhouette in the background. A figure in red is sitting on rocks near a grassy patch. The painting shows finely detailed brushstrokes depicting foliage, rocks, and textures. The color palette is soft and earthy with greens, browns, and light blues dominating, along with hues of pale pink and cream in the sky.

artworks.title: Train of Army Wagons Entering Petersburg, Virginia
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Brenda and Robert Edelson)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a convoy of wagons moving along a dirt road. In the foreground, there is a wooden fence, and sparse trees with bare branches frame the sides. On the horizon, there are trees, buildings, including a church spire, against an overcast sky. The style resembles a sepia-toned photograph, giving the scene an old-fashioned and muted look. The composition leads the eye along the road and through the landscape, suggesting a historical moment captured in time.

artworks.title: The Fencing Lesson [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Estate of William Woodville, VIII)
artworks.description: Three figures, a man, a woman, and a child, are depicted in a domestic setting. The man is seated on a carved wooden chair to the right center, facing slightly to the left. He has a mustache and short hair and is dressed in period clothing with a jacket and trousers. His hand rests on a cane or stick. Opposite him, a woman sits with her back to the viewer, wearing a long dress and a shawl, and her hair is tied up in a bun. Beside her is an infant or young child facing slightly toward the viewer, seated on another chair. The child standing on the floor wears a short coat, pants, and shoes, and appears to play while handing something to the seated man. A small, round table with a tablecloth and a tall glass or vase stands between the man and woman. The background shows an intricately sketched interior with visible arches and wooden beams, and light appears to filter through, casting shadows that define the room's ambiance.

artworks.title: Politics in an Oyster House
artworks.artist: Michele Fanoli, after Richard Caton Woodville
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Estate of William Woodville, VIII)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at a small wooden table. The man on the left has white hair and distinctive facial features, wearing a dark suit jacket with light pants and a white shirt. The other man wears a dark coat and pants, a top hat, and has a fuller beard. They are surrounded by various items on the table, a red curtain, a coat hanging on the wall, a cane umbrella, a small bag on the floor, and a folded newspaper. The room appears warm and shadowy, with muted colors.

artworks.title: Mexican News
artworks.artist: Alfred Jones, after Richard Caton Woodville
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Estate of William Woodville, VIII)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men on the porch of a building labeled "American Hotel." Most are in full-body view, some seated and others standing. A man is standing and reading from a large sheet, surrounded by others. The man reading has shoulder-length hair and wears a formal coat and a tall top hat. The men around him are dressed in 19th-century attire, including long coats, waistcoats, and top hats. Some men are smoking pipes. On the far right, a boy in tattered clothing holds a cup, standing next to a seated man with a bottle. The background features the hotel's wooden exterior, a barrel, plants, and a "Post Office" sign near the doorway. The scene is set during the daytime.

artworks.title: Street Musicians
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Eric R. Fox, 1985)

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The painting shows abstract forms resembling draped figures in conversation. It is in the style of Edgar Degas. Three silhouette-like figures clad in flowing robes are depicted blending into one another. The figures are rendered in muted earthy tones, with subtle variations of brown and beige. The brushstrokes create the appearance of fabric in motion, enhancing the impression of a dynamic interaction. The composition is simplified and stylized, focusing on movement and connection between the figures.

artworks.title: Men's Fashions
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Eric R. Fox, 1985)

artworks.title: Cour, rue de Valence
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Eric R. Fox, 1985)

artworks.title: Easthampton Elm in May
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a streetscape from a ground-level perspective. There is a broad, tree-lined avenue leading into the distance. Trees line both sides of the street. The left side is dominated by broad tree trunks with intricate branches overhead. The right side also has tall trees with interlacing twigs and leaves. Figures and a horse-drawn cart can be seen among the trees, adding depth to the scene. The artwork is created in a detailed etching style using fine lines for texture. The color scheme is monochrome with sepia tones.
